g.text: MV MOTOR FEEDER SCHEDULE (term. dip = bus dip + cable)
1. Switchgear: 4.16 kV metal-clad, arc-resistant (IEEE C37.20.7 Type 2B), drawout vacuum breakers,
2000 A main bus, 31.5 kA sym. interrupting, 125 V DC control.
2. Motor feeders: VCB + microprocessor motor protection relay (MPR) with RTD module (49).
87M (self-balancing CTs at motor terminal box) for motors >= 500 kW.
3. VFD feeders: MV drive (18-pulse / AFE, IEEE 519 compliant) incl. motor protection (49/46/37).
4. Auto-transfer: on loss of incomer (27 + 27R), incomer trips and tie closes (open transition);
manual return. Incomer/tie 2-out-of-3 interlock. MV motors restart by DCS sequence (no
5. CT secondaries 5 A, C200/C400 relaying class; metering 0.3 class. All relays IEC 61850 to ECS.
6. Motor space heaters 120 V fed from MCC-101A/B lighting panels; interlocked with VCB.
7. Cable sizes per CFU-000-EL-CBL-001; lengths are route estimates (layout not final).
